title: generate_image
description: Make a new picture from a description with the configured image-generation service (spec IM-6). It becomes an image of the project's assets: put it on a slide with insert_image. Only when the person asks for a new picture.

prompt.description: What the picture shows, in English, concrete: subject, setting, style.

shape.description: square 1024x1024, wide 1344x768 (a slide's width), tall 768x1344. Left out: wide.
